title: The default route was re-pointed

chain.subject: default
chain.why: The route all outbound traffic follows now points somewhere else.

evidence.describe: the default route now goes via 10.99.0.202 (was 10.99.0.201)

advice: Confirm this was intended. Compare the time against your change record: an unplanned default route change means outbound traffic is leaving through a path nobody chose.
